new_text: an audit of the read path traces the disagreement to a scale mismatch rather than a misread: the v3.3 solo baselines are byte-identical copies of pre-audit cells normalized against a 42656 MB/s fallback ceiling, while the pairwise cells were collected after the ceiling audit at 281600 MB/s, and rescaling the solo arm by 42656/281600 turns the v3.3 deltas into rises of 2 to 3 points ($n=12$ per arm), consistent with v2.1
